title: Glow Electric Boat night date experience in San Diego Bay
includes: Blanket (ask our crew at check in)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Safe and Fun experience for everyone
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
We’re excited to introduce our 60-minute Glow Boat Experience on Electric Boats — a romantic night date in San Diego Bay.

The boats glow beautifully after dark and come equipped with a Bluetooth Speaker so you can enjoy music while cruising.

Your group will be assigned one of our electric glow boats based on your group size. Both options offer the same Glow Electric Boat experience.

* Red Electric Glow Boat: Up to 4 adults + 1 small child (4–5 years old), maximum combined weight 650 lbs.
* White Electric Glow Boat: Up to 3 adults + 1 small child (4–5 years old), maximum combined weight 600 lbs.

The specific boat model is assigned by our team based on your group size.

Our crew provides full instructions and guides all boats on the water, with safety crew present. You’ll stay dry and comfortable the entire ride.
